name: Transference Vellum
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3th; Slot none; Price 500 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Originally designed to assist blacksmiths in reforging magical weapons, this magically treated leather, about the size of a dish rag, can be used to strip magical enhancements off of one magical armament, and move them to another.

By spending a minute rubbing a piece of transference vellum on a magical weapon, magical shield, or suit of magical armor, it removes the armament’s magical enhancements (such as a +1 weapon’s +1 enhancement bonus, as well special abilities such as the flaming ability) and places it on itself. Armaments that are enhanced in multiple ways, such as a shield being enhanced as both a weapon and as a shield, must have those enhancements transferred individually and you must choose which you wish to transfer to the vellum when you begin rubbing it on the armament. This process does not function on artifacts, legendary items, cursed items, or items that can only be destroyed through special processes.

While the transference vellum is enhanced with these enhancements, those magical enhancements are suppressed but can be detected with the detect magic spell or similar effect. A piece of transference vellum found already enhanced this way has its cost increased by the value of the enhancements applied to it.

Once imbued with magic, a piece of transference vellum can be turned over and rubbed onto a non-magical, masterwork weapon, masterwork shield or suit of masterwork armor, transferring the magic held within the transference vellum to the armament. This destroys the transference vellum, and only functions if it is generally the same kind of armament (armor to armor and weapon to weapon). Any properties that the new armament cannot accept (such as the vorpal weapon special ability on a club) are lost.

Transference vellum can also be used to transfer the enhancements to and from veils with the [Enhanced] descriptor, treating them as masterwork armaments of the type of item that they can be enhanced as. If a willing creature has a special ability that allows them to enhance themselves (such as the soulforge’s soul enhancement class feature), you can use the transference vellum to transfer those enhancements to and from that special ability as well, applying the vellum to that creature rather than their armaments or veil. Veils and abilities that have been enhanced multiple times must have each enhancement transferred individually.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells memorize page, crafter’s fortune; Cost 250 gp
